findings.finding: guidance_track is empty, but both sides of the Q1 FY2027 guidance are on file. The guidance (dc_g_*_q1fy27) matches the saved AV July-call transcript word for word, and the actuals are in the 10-Q dated 2026-10-28. Revenue: guided mid 90.40bn vs actual 92.279bn, about +2.1%. COGS: mid 29.70bn vs 29.720bn. Opex: mid 16.85bn vs 16.644bn (R&D 9,047 + S&M 5,716 + G&A 1,881). Other income/expense ex-OpenAI: about -0.1bn guided vs 38m reported including a 272m OpenAI gain, so about -0.23bn ex-OpenAI. Capex: guided over 50bn vs 45.2bn reported (third-party capacity delayed). Azure: guided about 45% cc vs 48% in the release (the release does not say whether 48% is constant currency). The numbers lane's gap note ('guided midpoints exist only in transcripts') did not take the documents lane's Q1 rows into account.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track (empty); gather/documents.json dc_g_rev_q1fy27, dc_g_cogs_q1fy27, dc_g_opex_q1fy27, dc_g_oie_q1fy27, dc_g_capex_q1fy27, dc_g_azure_q1fy27
findings.fix: Add guidance_track rows to gather/numbers.json for Q1 FY2027. Each row needs: guided low/high/mid, the source dc_call_fy26q4 (2026-07-29), the actual from pf_10q_20261028 (revenue 92,279m, COGS 29,720m, opex 16,644m) on the same GAAP basis, the actual/mid ratio, and the capex miss (45.2bn vs a >50bn floor, from dc_call_fy27q1). Check the ratio with ticker-check.

findings.finding: The basis of dc_capex_incl_leases_q1fy27 (45.2bn, labelled capex_including_finance_leases) does not add up. The call transcript, checked verbatim, says 'Capital expenditures were $45.2 billion' and separately 'finance leases were $7.4 billion'. Cash additions to PP&E were 39,367m (release), and 39.37 + 7.4 = 46.8bn, not 45.2bn. So the label and the arithmetic disagree. The Q4 FY2026 figure (41bn, dc_capex_incl_leases_q4fy26 vs 35.8bn cash PP&E) has the same unexplained definition. A capex-intensity driver built on this metric could be off by about 1.6bn a quarter, or mix bases against the >50bn guide.
findings.where: gather/documents.json facts dc_capex_incl_leases_q1fy27, dc_capex_incl_leases_q4fy26; guidance dc_g_capex_q2fy27, dc_g_capex_q1fy27
findings.fix: Relabel the metric as 'capital_expenditures_as_defined_on_call (cash PP&E plus finance leases per management definition, reconciliation unverified)'. Record the 7.4bn finance leases and the 39.367bn cash PP&E as separate facts. Build the capex driver on one basis, and use the same basis for the guide comparison.

findings.finding: Guidance for the fiscal year in progress was left out, even though it is in saved or checked documents. July call (gather/raw_documents/av_transcript_MSFT_2026Q4.json): full-year FY27 operating margin 'down less than 1 point', FY27 effective tax rate about 20%, and 'remain free cash flow positive in FY27'. October call (Fool page, checked verbatim): Q2 operating margin 'down slightly year-over-year'; calendar-year capex 'approximately $170 billion'. The July call said 'calendar year 2026 CapEx investment expectations remain unchanged', which fixes the period as CY2026. The documents lane's gaps wrongly say FY27 margin guidance was not captured and that the capex period is UNVERIFIED.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance (no FY2027 or CY2026 rows), gaps[0], gaps[1], notes 'dc MGMT (call, secondary) ... period UNVERIFIED'
findings.fix: Add guidance rows for: FY2027 operating_margin_change ≤ -0.01 vs FY2026 (dc_call_fy26q4), FY2027 effective_tax_rate 0.20 (dc_call_fy26q4), FY2027 free cash flow > 0 (dc_call_fy26q4, qualitative), Q2 FY2027 operating margin slightly down y/y (dc_call_fy27q1), and CY2026 capex about 170bn (dc_call_fy27q1, period from the July 'calendar year 2026' wording). Remove the two stale gaps.
